verdict.rationale: Capacities documents multiple capture channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Twitter, email, and mobile app search/capture) that let users save content into a space, but there is no evidence of a dedicated browser extension or web-clipper for grabbing pages/highlights directly from a browser. Missing for 10: a documented official browser clipper/extension, evidence of highlighting/annotation capture from web pages, and any independent confirmation of the capture flow's reliability.
